claim_text: A general dietary-gap concern does not establish vitamin B6 deficiency; intake from food and all existing supplements should be reviewed, and chronic high supplemental intake should be avoided because excess B6 can cause peripheral neuropathy.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe assessment of nutrient intake and avoid inappropriate or duplicate supplementation.

population.other_context: Adults reporting a dietary-gap concern; assess diet, current supplement use and symptoms.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Food, fortified foods and/or relevant supplement preparations; verify exact product form and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS B6 Health Professional Fact Sheet summarizes dietary sources, reference intakes, upper limits and neuropathy risk.
limitations: Dietary-gap flags are not diagnoses; no dose or recommendation can be inferred from this rule.
Source claim and cited underlying studies require full-text appraisal before approval.
